# TS9Designs

> TS9Designs is an engineering and building-design firm providing MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing), structural, fire protection, drafting, permit-documentation, construction-plan, and design-coordination services for residential and commercial projects in select U.S. states. Services requiring professional licensure are performed in accordance with the requirements of the applicable jurisdiction.

TS9Designs is not an architecture firm and does not represent itself as providing architectural services.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://ts9designs.com/): overview of services, pricing, and portfolio.
- [About](https://ts9designs.com/about.html): firm background and licensure notice.
- [Residential plans](https://ts9designs.com/residential.html): pre-designed and custom residential plan offerings.
- [Commercial projects](https://ts9designs.com/commercial.html): commercial build-out and ground-up project examples.
- [Permit-ready estimate calculator](https://ts9designs.com/permit-estimate.html): instant pricing-range estimate tool by project type, square footage, state, scope, and timeline.
- [Case studies](https://ts9designs.com/case-studies/index.html): detailed project write-ups (MEP scope, challenges, outcomes) for real completed projects.
- [Contact](https://ts9designs.com/contact.html): contact form and direct contact details.
- [Privacy policy](https://ts9designs.com/privacypolicy.html)

## Services

Building Design & Drafting, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Plumbing Engineering, Structural Design, Fire Protection Design, Fire Alarm Plans, Permit Drawings, Construction Documents, Code Coordination, Energy Compliance, 3D Rendering.

## Notes for automated tools / agents

- Pricing shown on the permit-estimate page is a non-binding range; final pricing follows a project-specific review.
- Project photography, drawing samples, and case-study copy on this site describe TS9Designs' own completed work.
- Contact for licensing/scope questions: info@ts9designs.com.
